---
name: Markdown Style
description: Prose and formatting conventions when writing or editing Markdown files.
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

Canonical Markdown guidelines live in [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md).

- Write prose as continuous lines. Do not hard-wrap paragraphs manually; rely on editor soft wrap.
- Preserve structure explicitly: headings, lists, tables, code fences, block quotes, and front matter keep their own line-based syntax.
- Leave long literals (URLs, inline code, table rows) on a single line when wrapping would hurt clarity.
